objective: Contract tests for the HTTP surface, Host/Origin guard, package.json and fallback performance (spec task 14, part 1).
context: Tests drive the real composition: in-process buildApp (explicit env, injected capture() fetch stub, quiet logger, listen(0,'127.0.0.1')) and the real `node src/server.js` via test/helpers/spawn-server.js (explicit env, PORT=0, live runs point TRIAGE_ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL at closed 127.0.0.1:9).
